result.summary: Checked the five leads. I opened the 1967 gazette (Decree No. 14, 12 states) and the 1976 gazette (Decree No. 12, 19 states) as page images and read them in full. The 1996 archivi.ng speech was seen only through a fetch-tool extract. policyvault (connection refused) and the UT map (bot wall) could not be opened. The nigeriareposit home page showed no 1967 decree item. Counts 21, 30 and 36, Kogi's 1991 creation, Ebonyi's decree and the FCT have no primary text read. The 1967 and 1976 schedules list provinces, divisions and districts, and both decrees set up boundary commissions, so the lines were not final. I did not compare the schedules with modern ADM1 units, so that question stays open. Reuse rights are unknown for every source, and the speech page says all rights reserved.

changes.why: Memo with a table per source, cross-cutting findings on Kogi, Ebonyi, the FCT and boundary adjustment, mapping to Stage 0/1 scope points, and the list of what still needs a source.

result.recommendation_reason: The 12 and 19 state counts are supported by primary text I read. The 21, 30 and 36 counts, Kogi, Ebonyi's decree and the FCT are not. Two leads were unreachable and rights are unknown for all five, so the chapter should wait for more sources.
